C0351.title: GM Hit by Credential Stuffing Attack Exposing Car Owner Personal Data
C0351.summary: In April 2022, General Motors detected malicious login activity and found that attackers had used credentials leaked from other non-GM sites to launch a credential stuffing attack against its online platform. After successfully accessing customer accounts, the attackers stole personal information and redeemed reward points for gift cards. GM subsequently required affected users to reset their pass
